speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start with your history: have you ever been diagnosed with syphilis or undergone treatment for it in the past?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. Did you experience any skin rashes, specifically on your palms or soles, or have you noticed any vision changes like difficulty seeing colors? Also, have you had any episodes of severe headache or meningitis symptoms in the past?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST TEST: MRI of the Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST IMAGES: Axial T2-weighted MRI slice showing non-enhancing white matter lesions in the parieto-occipital regions.
